definitions.short: Maazjah , the name of two Israelites
definitions.full: H4590. Maazyah or Maazyahu ַמעַזְיָה ַמעַזְיָהוּ, proper name, masculine of priests. 1 1Chr 24:18 ascribed to David's time, A Μοοζαλ , ᵐ5 L Μοοζια . 2 Neh 10:9 , Nehemiah's time, A Μααζεια , ᵐ5 L Μααζίας .
definitions.rootNote: or מַעַזְיָהוּ ; probably from 5756 (in the sense of protection) and 3050 ; rescue of Jah ;
